summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-12 found no newly verified AI-specific labor-market evidence materially changing Career Radar. Previously assessed BLS October payrolls, ILO exposure/review, OECD shortages and IMF Asian job-postings evidence are not duplicated. IMF October 18 global working paper is earlier research, not a new release since the last check; job postings are not realized employment, and exposure/adoption correlations do not prove AI-caused displacement.
